# Home {#home .unnumbered}

**placenta-xqtl-federated** lets cohorts with placental RNA-seq and genotype data take part in a multi-ancestry placental xQTL study without sharing individual-level data. Each cohort runs the pipeline on its own computers and sends only summary-level files (A–J) to MD Anderson Cancer Center (MDACC), which combines them across cohorts and ancestry groups.

Pipeline version: **`r PIPELINE_VERSION`**. These pages are built from the [`docs/` folder of the repository](https://github.com/sbresnahan/placenta-xqtl-federated/tree/main/docs); the same pages are included inside the pipeline image for offline reading.

## Where to start

- **Cohort investigators:** read the [Collaboration brief](#collaboration-brief) for the aims, the analyses each site runs and the files requested.
- **Analysts running the pipeline:** start with the quick start below, then the [HPC configuration guide](#hpc).
- **Results:** the appendix [Seadragon validation](#seadragon-validation) shows what the site smoke test checks on a real cluster.

## Quick start

The pipeline is distributed as one self-contained image (software, public reference data, Java and Nextflow). It needs no internet access at the site.

```bash
apptainer pull xqtl-federated_<version>.sif oras://ghcr.io/sbresnahan/xqtl-federated-sif:<version>
sha256sum -c xqtl-federated_<version>.sif.sha256
apptainer run xqtl-federated_<version>.sif bootstrap ./xqtl
./xqtl/run_xqtl.sh -profile seadragon,smoke
./xqtl/run_xqtl.sh -profile seadragon -params-file cohort.yml --mode prepare_references
./xqtl/run_xqtl.sh -profile seadragon -params-file cohort.yml --mode site
```

Replace `seadragon` with your scheduler and engine, for example `-profile slurm,apptainer -c mysite.config` (see [Executors](#hpc--executors)).

## The restricted file

> Site runs need `xqtl-restricted-<version>.tar.gz`, a small file that holds the shared splicing clusters and the MDACC signal list. MDACC sends it **by email** after the data-sharing agreement is approved. If your site has not received it, request it from the scientific contact, **Sean T. Bresnahan (stbresnahan@mdanderson.org)**, stating your cohort, the pipeline version and the approved agreement. Do not redistribute it.
